summary: Hugging Face's huge library of pretrained PyTorch image models, layers and training scripts for computer vision.

heroCommands.command: Follow the official docs at huggingface.co/docs/hub/timm

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: PyTorch Image Models (timm) is a collection of image models, layers, utilities, optimizers, schedulers, data loaders, augmentations and reference training and validation scripts. It brings together a wide range of state-of-the-art vision models and can reproduce ImageNet training results.
sixtySeconds.problem: Finding, comparing and training modern vision backbones means hunting through many repos. timm puts them in one consistent library.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for the largest collection of PyTorch image encoders and backbones, maintained by Hugging Face, with training, evaluation and inference scripts.

overview: timm includes many model families with pretrained weights, plus the building blocks used to make them.
The repo ships train, validation and inference scripts. Official documentation is at huggingface.co/docs/hub/timm; timmdocs and Papers with Code are other good references.
Community tools such as timmx export models to ONNX, CoreML, LiteRT and TensorRT. timm is Apache 2.0 licensed.
limitations: Install steps are in the docs, not the README
Large models need GPUs to train
